name: Line Item Tax 1
definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

CalculatedAmount.name: Calculated Amount
CalculatedAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from the calculation of the tax.

TaxPointDate.name: Tax Point Date
TaxPointDate.definition: Date of the tax point date when this tax, levy or duty becomes applicable.

CalculatedRate.name: Calculated Rate
CalculatedRate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of this tax, levy or duty.

CategoryCode.name: Category Code
CategoryCode.definition: Code specifying the category to which this tax, levy or duty applies, such as codes for 'exempt from tax', 'standard rate', "free export item - tax not charged'.

CategoryName.name: Category Name
CategoryName.definition: Category name, expressed as text, of the tax, levy or duty.
